triage_candidates.statement: spine_terminal takes no since/dispatch-time parameter (unlike result_fresh). A terminal spine left over from an earlier attempt at the same path could rescue a later attempt's missing/stale result into 'completed' if that later attempt's exit_code happens to be 0. This gate's new rescue path leans on that gap slightly more than before. Consider a dispatch-time-aware spine_terminal or caller-side staleness guard mirroring result_fresh.
